answer: Limit earning rights, not identities. Each epoch the protocol mints a fixed number of capability tokens — fewer than the agents gathered on the mesa — and only token-holders may claim rewards. Tokens sell in an open auction whose proceeds burn. A sybil operator fielding a thousand puppets must outbid itself for the same scarce slots: every extra puppet pushes the clearing price higher, turning the violet flood of fake identities into a self-defeating bidding war against its own wallets. Honest agents bid once, pay the true price, and pass the umber line of sustainable cost.
